Assessment
73-year-old male (MRN SYN-1480861) with new-onset diabetes mellitus diagnosed in May 2023 (A1c 8.6%, fasting glucose 176 mg/dL, weight 84 kg; prior A1c 5.6% in 2021, no family history of diabetes). In Nov 2023, A1c rose to 9.1% (fasting glucose 182 mg/dL, weight 85 kg) on metformin ER 1000 mg daily. Over the past 6 months (May 2024), A1c fell markedly from 9.1% to 6.0% (fasting glucose 114 mg/dL) and weight dropped 8 kg (from 85 kg to 77 kg) without any change in metformin dose, diet, or exercise.
